{
  "name": "loss_kl_divergence_000_advantage",
  "intuition": "A generative modeling inspired pairwise loss that treats the difference in log probabilities as logits and aligns the advantage signal with a soft target distribution, using a KL divergence paradigm instead of margin-based losses.",
  "pseudocode": "p = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)\ntarget = sigmoid(advantage_w - advantage_l)\nloss = kl_divergence(target || p)\nweighted_loss = weight * loss\nfinal_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    \n    p = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))\n    target = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l))\n    \n    # KL divergence between Bernoulli distributions: target*log(target/p) + (1-target)*log((1-target)/(1-p))\n    epsilon = 1e-7\n    p_clamped = ops.clamp(p, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)\n    target_clamped = ops.clamp(target, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)\n    term1 = ops.mul(target_clamped, ops.log(ops.div(target_clamped, p_clamped)))\n    term2 = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(target_clamped), target_clamped),\n                     ops.log(ops.div(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), target_clamped), ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), p_clamped))))\n    kl = ops.add(term1, term2)\n    if weight is not None:\n        kl = ops.mul(kl, weight)\n    return kl.mean()"
}
